CRQL.name: Counter Undertaking Request For Local Undertaking
CRQL.definition: Counter-undertaking issued to a correspondent with a request to issue a local undertaking.

CRQC.name: Counter Undertaking Request For Counter Undertaking
CRQC.definition: Counter-undertaking issued to a correspondent with a request to issue another counter-undertaking.

ISSU.name: Undertaking Issued Direct
ISSU.definition: Undertaking issued direct to the beneficiary.

ISCO.name: Undertaking Issued Via Confirming Party
ISCO.definition: Undertaking issued to the beneficiary via a confirming party.

ISAD.name: Undertaking Via Advising Party
ISAD.definition: Undertaking issued to the beneficiary via an advising party.
